title: Ogoma's lemma
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $M$ a finitely generated $A$-module and $S\subset A$ a multiplicative subset, with $S^{-1}M$ the localization of $M$. Let $\pi\in A$ and suppose $\operatorname{Ker}(\pi:S^{-1}M\to S^{-1}M)=\operatorname{Ker}(\pi^2:S^{-1}M\to S^{-1}M)$. Then there is $s\in S$ such that for every integer $n>0$, $\operatorname{Ker}(s^n\pi:M\to M)=\operatorname{Ker}((s^n\pi)^2:M\to M)$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07FC (lemma-ogoma, line 2287), Section 07FB
